readme: What an automated event can say happened to a ticket — the closed set apps/api/src/modules/comments/event-types.ts accepts on POST /api/tickets/:id/comments, and the one the chronology reads back. Declared here, next to ticket-vocabulary.json, because it is a vocabulary the front has to have copy for: an event whose type has no pt-BR phrase would reach the timeline raw. It is NOT in ticket-vocabulary.json on purpose — that file holds apps/web to copy for every word it names, and the web still renders the chronology from the fixture (PD-103), so putting these there would turn the web suite red for a screen that does not read them yet. Until PD-103, the API is the only reader of this file; the web joins it then.
